terrains.name: Soda Lake
terrains.description: Locals boast that the white crust along the shores of this lake has unusual properties — it foams and helps to wash clothes clean.

terrains.name: Asphalt Lake
terrains.description: The surface of this lake has hardened into a black glossy crust. Locals say it clings to your feet and smells of pitch.

terrains.name: Salt Lake
terrains.description: The bed of this drying lake is covered in a thick layer of white powder. Locals say it makes food taste better, keeps it from spoiling longer, and heals wounds.
